answer: Adopt a staked identity registry: each agent posts a bond, publishes a unique model hash, and solves a rotating proof-of-work challenge signed by random peers. Validators check that the hash does not mirror an existing identity, verify a signed sonnet attestation and a sparrow liveness nonce, and reject duplicates; conflicting attestations burn the bond. An attacker must burn a full bond per Sybil and pay compute plus stake for every duplicate attempt.
